narrative.OUTCOME:
**The prescribed arrangement does not yet meet the requirement.** After 457 development recordings, one controller was locked before 736 new-seed tests:

| Test cohort | Passed | Worst error | Hard stops |
|---|---:|---:|---:|
| Nominal: 10 masses × 10 forces × 7 angles | 683/700 | 0.580 N | 0 |
| Calibration/motion stress | 21/32 | 3.948 N | 0 |
| Repeated bumps/drift, up to 30 s | 1/4 | 0.691 N | 1 |

Two long runs leave the accepted travel band; one reaches a hard stop at **4.19 s**. These are finite simulation results, not hardware qualification.
narrative.VOLTAGE_RESULT: An unclipped nominal example is **bitwise identical at 32 and 48 V**. In one repeated-bump stress case, raising usable voltage reduces error from **2.748 to 0.650 N** and removes clipping; peak voltage becomes **33.02 V**. Current-response tuning remains unchanged. Both stress runs fail ±0.5 N. These separate diagnostics show that voltage helps saturation, but cannot establish force accuracy.
narrative.CONTROL_RESULT: Cell-mode feedback reduces the matched heavy-tool example from **1.074 to 0.459 N**, with **14.6 dB** less post-bump cell-band power. Twelve PI/modal families were compared at eleven development points; the selected family passed all eleven, worst **0.495 N**. Extra acceleration lead worsened the low-force bump. The independent grid then exposed failures.
narrative.CONTROL_RECOMMENDATION: Use this deterministic architecture as the development baseline. Identify installed acquisition/driver phase before tuning cell feedback: it damps near the selected mode but can reinforce vibration off-band. The current bound does not prove stability. Improve synchronized sensing, mode robustness and delayed recentering before a new, independently tested candidate.
narrative.FINAL_RECOMMENDATION: **Build an instrumented development prototype with a voice coil and the prescribed mechanics.** The selected controller is a reproducible baseline; it is not an accepted ±0.5 N solution.
narrative.FINAL_ACCEPTANCE: The next acceptance gates are fresh full-range and repeated-bump simulation tests, then independent physical force measurements. Extra voltage provides useful headroom, while structural phase, sensing errors and queued robot motion still need work. Keep the current failed cases as regression evidence.
